title: Tensor quotient detection modulo extended base-ideal powers
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra finite as an $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and $p$ a prime ideal of $R$. Set $A=R_p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $m$ its maximal ideal, and $Q$ the primes $q$ of $S$ contracting to $p$. Let $\varphi_q:A\to S_q$ be the canonical localized homomorphism. For every integer $n>0$, index set $\iota$, finite subset $t\subset\iota$, and families $r_i\in A$ and $s_i\in S$, if $\sum_{i\in t}\varphi_q(r_i)(s_i/1)\in(m^n)S_q$ for every $q\in Q$, then $\sum_{i\in t}(r_i\bmod m^n)\otimes s_i=0$ in $(A/m^n)\otimes_R S$ [def-weil-module-base-change].

source.place: Tag 07N9, quotient-product argument; Tags 00JA, 00CT and the cofinal-power argument in 0394

proof.text: For A=R_p and B=A tensor_R S, localization and finite base change make B a finite Noetherian A-algebra. The ring A/m^n is Artinian for n>0: its nilpotent maximal ideal has finite-dimensional successive quotients. Thus B/m^n B is Artinian and has finite discrete spectrum.
Localization prime correspondence identifies the primes of B/m^n B with Q. The Artinian product decomposition and localization/quotient equivalence identify B/m^n B with the product of S_q/(m^n)S_q.
Identify B/m^n B with (A/m^n) tensor_R S using tensor quotient and base-change cancellation. The q-component of the image of a pure tensor r tensor s is phi_q(r)*(s/1) modulo (m^n)S_q.

The hypothesis kills each component of the finite sum. Injectivity of the product map kills the sum itself. Empty sums are zero; if Q is empty the Artinian quotient has no primes and is the zero ring.

lean.statement:
theorem local_tensor_quotient_base_ideal_detection
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    let A := Localization.AtPrime p
    let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
    ∀ (ι : Type w) (t : Finset ι) (r : ι → A) (s : ι → S),
      (∀ q : p.primesOver S,
        (∑ i ∈ t, Localization.localRingHom p q.1 (algebraMap R S)
          (Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := q.1) (p := p)) (r i) *
          algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime q.1) (s i)) ∈
            (m ^ n).map (Localization.localRingHom p q.1 (algebraMap R S)
              (Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := q.1) (p := p)))) →
      (∑ i ∈ t, (Ideal.Quotient.mk (m ^ n) (r i)) ⊗ₜ[R] s i) = 0
